directions.personality_summary: Dark saturated arcade energy with a near-navy control-panel base and a lively green accent that reads like active cabinet buttons. The mood is social, fast, clear, and active.
directions.target_use_case: Multiplayer arcade lobbies, action-game menus, streamer-friendly tool surfaces, and dark runtime/editor UI where strong active states matter.
directions.flat_behavior_note: Solid tonal surfaces use the base as the root/panel family, with the accent reserved for primary actions, selected tabs, focus rings, and high-value toggles.
directions.raised_behavior_note: Filled buttons and selected chip/tab surfaces gain small extruded-flat offset duplicates in darker tonal variants; panels, inputs, lists, and passive labels stay flat for density.
directions.mobile_sizing_note: Mobile keeps the same personality but increases button/toggle targets toward iOS 44pt and Android 48dp floors; bright accent use is limited to action/focus roles.

directions.personality_summary: Calm modern minimal dark with cool slate surfaces, restrained blue accenting, and polished rounded controls. It is the safest modern candidate without becoming corporate-flat.
directions.target_use_case: Desktop tools, editor-style runtime UIs, settings-heavy games, launchers, and projects that want a premium dark default.
directions.flat_behavior_note: Most controls use subtle tonal separation and clear focus rings; the accent appears only in primary actions, selection, caret/focus, and important active states.
directions.raised_behavior_note: Raised mode is restrained: 1-2px hard offset or stronger outline on primary/button-like controls only, with no lifted shells or decorative depth.
directions.mobile_sizing_note: Mobile mode keeps the quiet palette but expands spacing and button-like constants toward 44pt/48dp floors; focus rings stay high-contrast because the accent is sparse.

directions.personality_summary: Friendly, childlike, and mobile-game-bright translated onto a dark berry-aubergine base with light bubblegum-pink action/focus accent. The mood is 'playful candy-counter at night' — tactile, social, and cheerful without becoming toy-store. Bubbliness comes from shape language (generous radius, pillowy buttons, fully-rounded chips) rather than material treatment.
directions.target_use_case: Casual games, cozy menus, tutorial-heavy experiences, family-friendly apps, and mobile-first game UIs that need warmth without asset-art dependency.
directions.flat_behavior_note: Controls use rounded dark berry solid fills, generous state-layer contrast, and cheerful but sparse pink accent placement; backgrounds stay simple and unillustrated.
directions.raised_behavior_note: Buttons, stepper-like controls, and selected playful affordances can use 3-5px extruded-flat offsets; large panels and text inputs remain flat.
directions.mobile_sizing_note: Mobile mode leans into larger buttons and toggles with 44pt/48dp minimum targets, while desktop mode tempers spacing for editor/runtime panels.

directions.personality_summary: Welcoming-daylight mood translated to dark mode: deep forest-teal surfaces with bright fresh-mint wayfinding, airy spacing, and a friendly social-lobby feel. The personality is 'fresh evening lobby' — approachable and bright without ever using a light surface.
directions.target_use_case: Community hubs, onboarding flows, cozy game menus, family-friendly settings screens, and bright mobile experiences.
directions.flat_behavior_note: Flat mode uses dark teal tonal surfaces with clear high-contrast mint for primary/focus/selection and quiet secondary roles rather than illustration. Airy spacing carries the daylight feel.
directions.raised_behavior_note: Raised mode adds tactile depth mainly to primary actions and cards-as-actions; ordinary panels, lists, and text fields remain flat for readability.
directions.mobile_sizing_note: Mobile mode uses 44pt iOS and 48dp Android floor language with slightly more breathing room around touch clusters to preserve the daylight calm.

directions.personality_summary: The maximum MD3 Expressive statement: bold, celebratory, high-contrast, and saturated without glow or nightclub cues. It tests how expressive NeoCade can be while staying professional.
directions.target_use_case: Mini-game launchers, achievement/reward surfaces, party-game menus, showcase scenes, and brand-forward projects that still need all controls to be readable.
directions.flat_behavior_note: Flat mode uses a disciplined dark surface ladder with the accent for critical actions, focus, selected states, progress, and reward-like callouts.
directions.raised_behavior_note: Raised mode can use stronger extruded-flat button offsets and bolder corner radii on button-like controls, but range controls, inputs, tree/list rows, and panels stay stable and flat.
directions.mobile_sizing_note: Mobile mode preserves the celebratory accent but enlarges touch affordances to 44pt/48dp targets and avoids filling every row with gold.
